# fjordrun_deployment (Data Source)

A deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "deployment_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_deployment" "this" {
  id = var.deployment_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Deployment ID.

### Read-Only

- `commit_author` (String) Commit author.
- `commit_message` (String) Commit message.
- `commit_sha` (String) Commit.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.
- `finished_at` (String) End time.
- `image` (String) Deployed image.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether it serves the service.
- `service_id` (String) Service ID.
- `started_at` (String) Start time.
- `status` (String) `queued`, `building`, `deploying`, `success`, `failed`, `crashed`, `cancelled`, `skipped` or `removed`.
- `trigger` (String) What started it.
